name: Bear’s Endurance, Greater
body:
School transmutation; Level alchemist 5, bloodrager 4, cleric/oracle 5, druid 5, lathspell 4, magus 5, psychic 5, ranger 4, shaman 5, sorcerer/wizard 5, summoner 5, unchained summoner 5

Duration 10 min./2 levels

This spell functions as bear’s endurance, except it grants an enhancement bonus to Constitution equal to 1/2 your caster level.
